subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

At this important junctur, we asked several experts from different fields what their burning question about the coronavirus is.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"junctur"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "juncture".**
 
• **English meaning:** A particular point in events or time. (समय का विशेष बिंदु)
 
 
• **Example: **At this critical juncture, we cannot afford to make any mistakes.
 
 
 
• **"Juncture"** (Correct spelling) refers to a particular point in events or time. (समय का विशेष बिंदु)
 
 
• **Example: **At this critical** juncture,** we need to stay calm and focused.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **junctur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Question** (प्रश्न): A sentence or phrase used to find out information.

 
 
• **Example:** She raised her hand to ask a question.
 
 
 
• **Burning** (जलता हुआ): Extremely hot or on fire; also used metaphorically to describe something very intense or urgent.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a burning desire to succeed.
 
 
 
• **Fields** (क्षेत्र): Areas of open land or domains of study or activity.
 
 
• **Example:** The researchers came from various fields of science.
